question: Will Gianni Infantino resign as FIFA President by August 31, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Gianni Infantino has publicly announced and confirmed his resignation as FIFA President, and that resignation has taken effect or been formally accepted by FIFA, on or before August 31, 2026 (UTC), as reported by FIFA's official communications.
- "No": Wins if Gianni Infantino has not resigned as FIFA President by the end of August 31, 2026 (UTC) — i.e., no confirmed, effective resignation has been announced or accepted by that date.

Clarifications:
- A temporary absence, suspension, or leave of absence does not constitute a resignation; only a formal, confirmed departure from the presidency counts.
- A resignation announcement counts only when it has been officially confirmed by FIFA; an unconfirmed report or rumor does not suffice.
